issues.body:
I found some nits, attached, in unified diff format.

[draft-irtf-rasprg-analysing-ietf-data-01.diff.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34527139/draft-irtf-rasprg-analysing-ietf-data-01.diff.txt)

Also, here are a couple more comments:

Orcid Identifiers are mentioned, but there is no citation.  I don't know offhand how well known Orcid is to those likely to read this draft if it is published as an RFC, but a citation, or at least a short description might be helpful.

There is no link to a copy of Marshall Rose's **_The Open Book_**.  It is available from the Internet Archive at https://archive.org/details/openbookpractica00rose/mode/2up.
